_README: Group 3 region coverage for Sanskar's six-region Group 1 closure. Group 3 has emitted ONE observation, for Thane Creek. It holds no observation, source id or runtime path for any other region. This file states that plainly and proves what Group 3 can produce instead.

what_group3_actually_has.source: Open-Meteo.com - EXTERNAL LIVE API, CC-BY 4.0, keyless
what_group3_actually_has.runtime_path: POST /observations with Idempotency-Key: IK-TC-Z03-EXT-OPENMETEO-OBS001, then GET /observations/{observation_id}
what_group3_actually_has.label: VERIFIED - Group 3 ran it and holds the output

what_group3_does_NOT_have._thane_note: 'Thane' as a separate region is also absent. Every Group 3 observation id begins TC- for the Thane CREEK survey, which is a specific mangrove site inside Thane district, not the district. Treating them as the same region would be a substitution.
what_group3_does_NOT_have._why_this_is_the_answer: Sanskar asked for no manually created IDs and no substituted fixtures. Group 3 agrees, and therefore supplies none. An id invented to fill a row on a closure board is the exact failure the request is guarding against.

what_group3_CAN_produce_today._claim: Every one of the five regions is reachable through the SAME proven path Thane Creek used. Open-Meteo is keyless and global; the contract, the emitter, the validator and the acceptance sequence are unchanged.
what_group3_CAN_produce_today._verified_how: Live probe of all five regions. Each returned HTTP 200 with a current reading.
what_group3_CAN_produce_today._effort: About 15 minutes per region once the zone identity is agreed.
_what_is_needed_first: AUTHORITATIVE ZONE DEFINITION for each region. Group 3 does not own zone polygons - Group 2 does. Today's observation was checked against Group 2's Thane Creek polygon. Coordinates below are city-centre points and are PROVISIONAL, not approved zones.
A survey/zone identifier per region so observation_id is truthful. Thane Creek is TC-Z03. The other five have no assigned survey or zone code.
Confirmation from Group 1 that five more external_api observations are wanted in the canonical store, rather than one region being the demo path.

_honest_caveat: These would be EXTERNAL LIVE API observations - synthetic_state CONTROLLED, is_synthetic true, hardware_verified false. They are real third-party weather data, not Group 3 field sensing. Six regions of external API data is still zero regions of hardware evidence.
